scope: Fixed exact binary model; component selection and bounded disposable memoization, not calibrated learning

fixed_cases: ordinary accepted event statistics and probabilities
omissions.retained: All case identities/priors/modes/strategies/metadata, input sequences, event statuses, complete limits with failure statistics, initial/final statistics, untimed phase summaries and inventory peaks; new cases retain full event/query details.
omissions.inventory_peaks: Derived from actual operation rows; phase stock maxima, not sums or allocated bytes.
